name: Relevium Phone QA Medical Rubric
description: Medical front-desk phone quality rubric for Relevium Pain Specialists. Edit qa_rules/current in Firestore to evolve without redeploying.

rules.label: Agent stated their name
rules.description: The agent clearly introduces themselves by name during the call.
rules.pass_criteria: Agent says their first name (or full name) clearly enough that a caller would know who they are speaking with.

rules.label: Practice greeting
rules.description: Agent greets with Relevium / practice identity.
rules.pass_criteria: Agent identifies the practice (e.g. Relevium Pain Specialists) or equivalent office identity in the greeting or early on the call.

rules.label: Patient identity verification
rules.description: Agent verifies the patient before discussing protected details.
rules.pass_criteria: Before sharing clinical, billing, or appointment details tied to a specific patient, agent verifies identity (typically full name + DOB or another approved identifier). Pass if the call never reaches PHI disclosure and verification was not yet required. Auto-fail if PHI is disclosed without verification.

rules.label: Privacy / HIPAA hygiene
rules.description: Agent protects PHI and avoids discussing care with unverified parties.
rules.pass_criteria: Agent does not leave detailed clinical messages on unsecured voicemail, discuss care with unverified third parties, or overshare PHI. Pass if no PHI risk moments occur.

rules.label: Empathy & tone
rules.description: Warm, patient-centered tone throughout the interaction.
rules.pass_criteria: Tone is warm and respectful; acknowledges caller concern; score_1_to_10 must be provided (pass if score >= 7).

rules.label: Clinical escalation when needed
rules.description: Urgent clinical concerns are escalated appropriately.
rules.pass_criteria: If the caller reports urgent/emergent symptoms, agent follows escalation (nurse/provider/ER guidance) rather than treating it as routine scheduling only. Pass if no urgent clinical content is present.

rules.label: Scheduling accuracy
rules.pass_criteria: When scheduling or changing an appointment, agent confirms date, time, location/provider as applicable, and any prep instructions.

rules.label: Insurance / auth clarity
rules.description: Coverage and authorization next steps are clear when relevant.
rules.pass_criteria: When insurance, referrals, or prior auth are discussed, agent explains status and owned next steps without leaving the caller confused.

rules.label: Medication refill process
rules.description: Refill requests follow office protocol and expectations.
rules.pass_criteria: For refill requests, agent follows process (portal/pharmacy/provider review), sets expectations on timing, and does not promise controlled substances outside protocol.

rules.label: Transfers within limit
rules.pass_criteria: transfer_count is <= soft limit (1). Auto-fail the call if transfer_count >= 3. Pass if transfers are 0 or 1 and handled smoothly.

rules.label: First Call Resolution
rules.description: Caller's need is resolved on this call without requiring another call back for the same issue.
rules.pass_criteria: The caller's stated need is addressed to completion, or a clear owned next step is set that does not require the caller to re-explain from scratch on a new call.

rules.label: Ownership & next steps
rules.description: Clear ownership and next steps for the caller.
rules.pass_criteria: Agent summarizes what will happen next, who owns it, and any timing the caller should expect.

rules.label: Does not talk over / dismiss
rules.description: Agent does not talk over, interrupt harshly, or dismiss the caller.
rules.pass_criteria: Agent lets the caller finish key points; does not dismiss concerns; interruptions are rare and polite if present.

rules.label: Prompt live engagement
rules.description: Live agent engages without a long unexplained delay when detectable.
rules.pass_criteria: When time-to-answer is detectable, a live agent greets within a reasonable window without long unexplained silence. If not detectable from transcript, mark passed=true with notes explaining uncertainty (do not fail solely for missing timing).
